tests.name: bson_document_size_error_check
tests.intent: Probes binary reader BSON parsing with a document size smaller than the minimum prefix to check if the error is successfully handled.

tests.name: bson_valid_minimum_document
tests.intent: Probes binary reader BSON parsing with a minimal valid BSON document size to ensure correct flow.

tests.name: ubjson_ndarray_invalid_type_marker
tests.intent: Probes binary reader UBJSON ndarray size parsing with an invalid type marker like 'N' inside dimensions.

tests.name: bjdata_ndarray_type_name_check
tests.intent: Probes BJData ndarray dtype processing and ensures valid type names are retrieved without hitting null pointers.

tests.name: ubjson_size_type_excluded_marker_f

tests.name: ubjson_size_type_excluded_marker_z
tests.intent: Probes UBJSON optimized container parsing with an excluded type marker 'Z' to verify proper rejection.

tests.intent: Probes BJData/UBJSON typed run parsing with the 'm' (uint32) type marker.

tests.name: ubjson_typed_run_uint64_bjdata
tests.intent: Probes BJData/UBJSON typed run parsing with the 'M' (uint64) type marker.

tests.name: bjdata_binary_marker_b
